object.question: When does Outrage trigger, what is paid, and what if the player has no matching card or the supporter stack is full?

object.expected_answer: Another player removing sympathy or moving any warriors into sympathetic clearing owes one matching hand card including bird to supporters. Merely battling without removing sympathy is not trigger. If none matching show hand to Alliance; Alliance draws deck card to supporters. No bases caps stack at five; incoming overflow discarded.

source_passages.quotation: **Outrage:** Each time another player **removes sympathy** or **moves any warriors into a sympathetic clearing**, that player adds one matching hand card (birds count) to Supporters. Moving a group costs one card per affected move, rather than one per warrior. If no matching cards including birds, show hand to Alliance, then Alliance draws one deck card into Supporters. **If Supporters is full, discard the incoming Outrage card; payment or the no-match draw still occurs.** Merely battling there is no trigger unless sympathy is removed; placing warriors there and moving only Vagabond pawn do not trigger it.

answer.ruling: Outrage triggers when another player removes sympathy or moves any warriors into a sympathetic clearing. That player adds one matching card from hand to Supporters (birds count), once per affected move rather than per warrior in a group. Merely battling there is not a trigger unless sympathy is removed; placing warriors there and moving only the Vagabond pawn do not trigger it.

answer.part: No matching card and full Supporters stack
answer.ruling: If the player has no matching card, including birds, they show their hand to the Alliance, then the Alliance draws one deck card into Supporters. If Supporters is full, the incoming Outrage card is discarded; the payment or no-match draw still happens.

answer.ruling: Outrage triggers when another player removes sympathy or moves any warriors into a sympathetic clearing. That player adds one hand card matching the clearing (birds count) to Supporters; moving a group costs one card for the move, not per warrior. Battling alone does not trigger it unless sympathy is removed. Placing warriors there or moving only the Vagabond pawn does not trigger it.

If the player has no matching card including birds, they show their hand to Alliance, and Alliance draws one card from the deck into Supporters. If Supporters is full, discard the incoming Outrage card; the payment or no-match draw still occurs.

Their conditional consequence is correct for every legal state satisfying the question antecedent.

source_authority_evidence.quotation: 8.2.6 Outrage.Whenever another player removes a sympathy token or moves any warriors into a sympathetic clearing, they must add one card matching the affected clearing from their hand to the Supporters stack. If they have no matching cards *(including no birds)*, they must show their hand to the Alliance, and then the Alliance draws a card from the deck and adds it to the Supporters stack.

1. Capacity.If the Alliance has no bases on the map, the Supporters stack can only hold up to five cards. If the Alliance would gain a supporter but the stack cannot hold it, that card is discarded. If any bases are on the map, the Supporters stack can hold unlimited cards.

source_authority_evidence.section: 2.1.1 Birds Are Wild and Forced Effects
quotations: 2.1.1 Birds Are Wild.You can treat any bird card as a card of another suit, even if you must spend, take, or give multiple cards of the same suit.
1. Forced Effects.If you are prompted to discard or give cards of non-bird suits, you must treat your bird cards as a prompted suit.

4.2 Move

source_authority_evidence.application: A move can contain multiple warriors; 8.2.6 charges one card whenever that move enters sympathy, not one card per warrior.

source_authority_evidence.application: Original extracted rule text agrees with A1 and A2, including the five-without-bases/unlimited-with-base capacity and the normal/no-match Outrage procedure.

frozen_summary_evidence.quotation: **Outrage:** Each time another player **removes sympathy** or **moves any warriors into a sympathetic clearing**, that player adds one matching hand card (birds count) to Supporters. Moving a group costs one card per affected move, rather than one per warrior. If no matching cards including birds, show hand to Alliance, then Alliance draws one deck card into Supporters. **If Supporters is full, discard the incoming Outrage card; payment or the no-match draw still occurs.** Merely battling there is no trigger unless sympathy is removed; placing warriors there and moving only Vagabond pawn do not trigger it.

**Guerrilla War:** When Alliance defends, Alliance uses higher die and attacker lower; warrior caps still apply. **Supporters** are a separate face-down stack, inspectable by Alliance. They can be spent only for suit; they do not count as hand cards or toward hand limit. With no bases on map, maximum **five supporters**; incoming cards beyond capacity are discarded. With any base, unlimited supporters.
